projection.definition: S_target = mean(S_case * exp(+i * target dot phase_vector))

analysis.absorption_region_definition: positive real part within the optical detection window
analysis.emission_region_definition: negative real part within the optical detection window
analysis.peak_position_definition: energy at maximum complex magnitude within the optical detection window
analysis.integrated_absolute_definition: integral of complex magnitude over energy

metadata.scope: full-field pump-plus-probe master-equation propagation at one delay
metadata.readout: relative_response = (A_pump_probe - A_probe_only) / A_probe_only, A = omega * Im[P(omega) * conj(E_probe(omega))]
